scope: Full local adapter checkout; all resource action declarations inventoried with static AST parsing. Deep source paths cover core work-item/assignment lifecycle, relations, comments/mentions, planning helpers, activity, selected attachments, authentication/context, token storage and interface/server construction. Not every-action audit, SDK/backend audit, security certification or runtime verification. Upstream Plane behavior remains separately assessed.

lifecycle_review.create: Typed SDK project/work-item creation with no local task persistence or idempotency journal
lifecycle_review.select: PQL list/search/count with upstream query execution and preserved pagination
lifecycle_review.claim: No claim action; assignee helper uses an unguarded retrieve/replace list sequence
lifecycle_review.progress: Upstream comments, mentions, links, pages and files; no attempt/checkpoint contract
lifecycle_review.review: No adapter task submission/review decision or evidence gate; state updates forwarded to Plane
lifecycle_review.complete: Generic state update, or date-based cycle completion; acceptance semantics delegated upstream
lifecycle_review.cancel: Delete/archive API calls; no execution cancellation, lease or child coordination
lifecycle_review.recover: Client must reconcile upstream partial effects after failure; multi-call helpers lack rollback and OAuth token-store recovery is separate from work
